description: This file defines the Customer CustomField controller class in the OpenCart admin module. It manages the CRUD operations for customer custom fields, including listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting custom fields, as well as generating views and handling requests.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer custom fields in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the custom fields list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of custom fields via getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the data for listing custom fields, including sorting, pagination, and data preparation for the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a customer custom field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a custom field based on submitted form data.
